title: Release arrives where seeking kneels into service
subtitle: Siree Raag · Ang 52
summary: The shabad begins by declaring that release comes only through the True Name. It turns seeking toward the Guru's feet, true service, and the hidden Lord found when the True Guru is pleased.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person who keeps searching but cannot land. Taken steadily, it ends the addiction to spiritual novelty and teaches that arrival comes through service, not endless roaming.
takeaway: Keep this in front of you: seeking matures when it bows into the Name and service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਛੂਟਨੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janahu sun bhaieeho chhooTan saachai nai ||
lines.translation: O Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: release comes only through the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan sarevane teerath har kaa naau ||
lines.translation: Worship the Feet of the Guru. Let the Name of the Lord be your sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aagai dharageh ma(n)ne'eeh milai nithaave thaau ||1||
lines.translation: Hereafter, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord; there, even the homeless find a home. ||1||
O Siblings of Destiny, service to the True Guru alone is True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur tuThai paieeaai pooran alakh abhev ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is pleased, we obtain the Perfect, Unseen, Unknowable Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur viTahu vaariaa jin dhitaa sach naau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has bestowed the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadhin sach salaahanaa sache ke gun gaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, I praise the True One; I sing the Glorious Praises of the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache sachaa naau ||2||
lines.translation: True is the food, and true are the clothes, of those who chant the True Name of the True One. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas giraas na visarai safal moorat gur aap ||
lines.translation: With each breath and morsel of food, do not forget the Guru, the Embodiment of Fulfillment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਿਸਈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur jevadd avar na dhisiee aaTh pahar tis jaap ||
lines.translation: None is seen to be as great as the Guru. Meditate on Him twenty-four hours a day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: nadhar kare taa paieeaai sach naam gunataas ||3||
lines.translation: As He casts His Glance of Grace, we obtain the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur paramesar ek hai sabh meh rahiaa samai ||
lines.translation: The Guru and the Transcendent Lord are one and the same, pervading and permeating amongst all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau poorab likhiaa seiee naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny, meditate on the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੩੦॥੧੦੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur saranaagatee marai na aavai jai ||4||30||100||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Guru, who does not die, or come and go in reincarnation. ||4||30||100||

structure: The shabad begins by stripping release away from every substitute except the True Name.
From there it turns the seeker toward the Guru's feet until even homelessness becomes sheltered.
The closing movement rests by calling service to the True Guru the one path that actually arrives.
